app_info.subtitle: Track time and invoices
app_info.description: Tallied helps freelancers and small teams log work, review hours and unbilled totals, reconstruct missed time from supplied activity, and create, send, and track client invoices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves time entries from the connected workspace without changing them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change time entries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates summaries from existing workspace time entries without persisting changes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change workspace data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves clients, projects, aliases, and rates from the connected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change workspace data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves invoice summaries and calculated outstanding totals without changing invoices.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change invoices.

justifications.read_only_justification: Retrieves an existing invoice and its line items without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change the invoice.

justifications.read_only_justification: Calculates a possible invoice from unbilled entries without creating an invoice or marking entries invoiced.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only reads private workspace data and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, or otherwise change workspace data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Analyzes user-supplied activity and existing entries to return proposals without saving them.
justifications.open_world_justification: Processes activity supplied to the tool and private workspace data without contacting external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not create, delete, or change time entries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates one time entry in the connected workspace after validation and duplicate checks.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a time entry but does not delete or overwrite an existing entry.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates validated time entries in the connected workspace and reports each result.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds time entries but does not delete or overwrite existing entries.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates selected fields on an existing time entry in the connected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Overwrites existing time-entry values, though it returns both the previous and updated entry.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes the selected time entry when the caller passes confirm: true.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently deletes a time entry after an explicit confirmation parameter.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a client record in the connected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a client record but does not delete or overwrite an existing record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a project record in the connected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a project record but does not delete or overwrite an existing record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private draft invoice and associates its unbilled time entries with that draft.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not publish or send anything externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a reversible draft without deleting records or contacting the client.

justifications.read_only_justification: Marks a selected invoice as paid in the connected workspace.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private workspace and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes payment status but does not delete invoices or perform an irreversible external transaction.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends an invoice email and updates the invoice's sent status.
justifications.open_world_justification: Sends a real email to the client and may create a Stripe payment link.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or overwrite invoices, although the sent email cannot be recalled.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes an invoice to void status and releases its associated time entries when confirm: true.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change the status shown on a previously sent invoice's tokenized public page.
justifications.destructive_justification: Voids the invoice and alters its invoicing associations after an explicit confirmation parameter.

test_cases.description: Log a single past time entry to a known project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Log 2 hours of homepage QA for Acme on 2026-09-08.
test_cases.expected_output: Logs the entry or asks for project clarification if Acme is ambiguous, then confirms the parsed date and duration.

test_cases.description: Summarize billable work by project for a bounded period.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my billable hours by project for last week.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested period's hours, billable totals, unbilled value, and project breakdown.

test_cases.description: Propose a catch-up entry from supplied activity without saving it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Reconstruct Tuesday from this activity: calendar event 'Acme design review' from 10:00 to 11:00 on 2026-09-08.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a project-matched proposal with confidence and does not create a time entry until the user confirms it.

test_cases.description: Preview an invoice before creating it.
test_cases.user_prompt: What can I invoice Acme for through the end of August? Group the lines by project.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns unbilled line items, hours, total, and any missing billing-email warning without creating an invoice.

test_cases.description: Send a reviewed draft invoice only on explicit instruction.
test_cases.user_prompt: I've reviewed draft invoice INV-0007. Send it to the client now.
test_cases.expected_output: Emails the invoice to its billing recipient, marks it sent, and reports the recipient and payment-link availability.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Tallied for calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with Acme tomorrow at 10 AM.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot create calendar events or reminders.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Tallied to retrieve activity from an unconnected service.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Look through my GitHub commits from yesterday and log them automatically.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it can only analyze activity the user or another connected tool supplies.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Tallied for unrelated general information.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be in Seattle this weekend?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather information is outside its time-tracking and invoicing workflows.
